summary: Parked-up residential kerb near shops; apartments 20 m across the road, sloping.

best_section.where: Riverview Terrace east kerb, just south of the corner cafe

drivers.seclusion: Apartments about 21-22 m across the road, and unmapped units beside the kerb on the east side 10-13 m away; not secluded.
drivers.access_and_room: Parallel parking lane with other cars in it; room to pull in clear of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side of the town-centre street, moderate through traffic.
drivers.convention: Daytime 2P and 1/4P signs; cars park here but it is a residential and retail street.

flags: Steep: about 4% over the best section, 5% over the full stretch
Unmapped buildings look residential beside the kerb
Mapped gates are not on the access
sun_shade: Mostly open; trees on the east side shade the kerb from about 25 m south.
